title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.03301v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. translated_title: 开放多智能体系统中强化学习的公理化框架
translated_abstract: 开放多智能体系统（其中只有一部分智能体是可控的）是智能电网等现实应用领域的核心，但此类系统缺乏一个有原则的强化学习算法设计基础。我们通过 n 智能体临时团队协作（n-agent ad hoc teamwork, NAHT）这一新兴的开放多智能体环境学习框架来研究该设定。我们提出了一个公理化框架，从 Shapley 公理（有效性、对称性与线性性）出发推导价值函数学习，将这些公理视为结构性约束而非启发式设计选择。这一表述建立在新颖的 NAHT 分解之上，该分解刻画了开放系统与完全可控多智能体系统之间的根本差异，并为学习建立了合作博弈论基础。我们进一步证明，在学习个体价值函数时强制执行这些公理可以恢复 Dec-POMDP 的 Shapley 值，从而在……之间架起一座有原则的桥梁（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一个以 Shapley 公理为结构性约束的公理化框架，通过新颖的 NAHT 分解刻画开放与完全可控多智能体系统的本质差异，为开放多智能体系统的强化学习奠定合作博弈论基础，并证明对个体价值函数施加这些公理可恢复 Dec-POMDP 的 Shapley 值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning in open multi-agent systems from the Shapley axioms, grounded in a novel NAHT decomposition that establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation and recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs.
